Providing you with the highest quality of features

Spark Arabia, a trading and contracting establishment operating from the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, is a rapidly expanding organization offering a wide range of engineering support in the areas of construction, general contracting, industrial contracting and support (civil, electrical, instrument, and mechanical contract), operation and maintenance, and human resource services.

Human Resource & Support Services

Spark Arabia

Spark Arabia has a project support program where we support our customers with their manpower needs. We have hands-on working experience providing a large number of manpower needs. We offer engineering support for civil, electrical, instrument and mechanical, operation and maintenance, administrative support, human resource, janitorial, and general services. Our services extend to petrochemical, refinery, pulp and paper, power generation industries, and utility industries. Staffs are officially highly skilled and well-trained as management compliance.
